decisions.reason: A safety shoe line fits the firm's core industrial footwear business, and a large established German manufacturer would usually give such a recent line more time before withdrawing it.
A comfort insole is a plausible add-on to work shoes but is easier to rationalise if demand is weak, so the risk is somewhat higher even though it still supports the main product range.
A supportive insole is strategically adjacent to the firm's work-shoe business, but as a narrower accessory offering it is somewhat more exposed to consolidation than core footwear lines.
An ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page on the website, signalling stronger commercial commitment and a good fit with the firm's main market.
Firefighter and rescue boots are a credible specialist extension for a safety-footwear producer, but their niche nature makes them slightly more vulnerable than broad occupational lines.
A moulded insole shown on the home page suggests active promotion and cross-selling potential with work shoes, which lowers the likelihood of an early withdrawal.
